# MODOFORMA

> MODOFORMA is a Toronto-based creative engine that collaborates with interior designers, architects, and developers, shaping concepts into experiences.

## About

MODOFORMA partners with interior designers, architects, and developers to take concepts from idea through refinement into finished experiences. Their philosophy: design is not decoration, but a way of thinking — a way of living. Related/partner brands: colorlab. (design management), MODDDO, NERO Cucine, Canova.

- Location: 1411-A Dufferin St., Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Email: start@modoforma.com
- Phone: +416-450-9525
- Hours: By appointment only
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/modoforma/
